1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 c5 4.d5 exd5 5.cxd.strategy: Recaptures with the c-pawn, which gives White a pawn on d5 and a central majority but leaves Black the majority on the queenside. Each side now plays for its own pawn break in a sharp, unbalanced game.
Supports the c5 pawn, restrains White's e5 advance and frees the diagonal of the light-squared bishop. Black accepts White's space in return for the half-open e-file and a majority on the queenside.
